title: Time Series in Foundry — Modeling Counterparty Risk Trajectories and Early-Warning Indicator Pipelines
validation_scope: Daily PySpark trajectory transform with 4 component signals (sanctions decay 90-day half-life, log-scaled 90-day media count, abs-z-score transaction anomaly, KYC freshness) and weighted composite scoring.
Feature schema with mathematical definitions, audit-defensibility notes, and alternative composite functions (Beneish-M, Dechow-F) for sensitivity analysis.
Pipeline template with Code Repo + Pipeline Builder hybrid pattern + AlertEntry emission + monitoring SLAs.
4 threshold-to-Action rules connecting trajectory changes to Article 005 Actions framework, including CUSUM/z-score change-point detection and queue-staleness 14-day failsafe.

8-section SR 11-7 / OCC 2011-12 validation framework: model identification, pre-deployment (conceptual + quantitative + outcomes-based + documentation), ongoing monitoring, periodic revalidation, model-change governance, independence, examiner readiness.

Deterministic synthetic-data generator producing 50-counterparty × 365-day time series with 2 injected deterioration patterns; CP-SYN-007 breaches at day 285 (sanctions buildup), CP-SYN-023 breaches at day 255 (media spike); reproducible under seed=42.
known_limits: Composite weights (0.40/0.25/0.20/0.15) and thresholds (0.60/0.85/z=3.0) are ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY; production requires institutional calibration per SR 11-7.
Synthetic data is deterministic-by-seed but not representative of any institution's actual risk distribution.
Component-signal functional forms (decay, log-scale, z-score, linear ramp) are reasonable defaults; sensitivity analysis is part of SR 11-7 conceptual-soundness validation.
Pipeline Builder operator vocabulary is Foundry-specific; Snowflake/Databricks equivalents require different operator names.
Change-point rule uses |z-score| as CUSUM proxy; rigorous Page-1954 CUSUM and Bayesian change-point methods are the topic of Stochastic Article 005 (referenced as graduation path).
framing_discipline: EVERY threshold, weight, and decision rule is flagged 'illustrative only; production institution must validate and document under their own model-risk governance program.' The platform provides the time-series primitives; the institution provides the model-risk discipline. The SR 11-7 framework in model_governance/ is what the institution must execute.
